title: Cat-Ears Lace Bodysuit with Detachable Tail | Black | Floral lace | Halloween Intimates | 82% Nylon, 18% Spandex lace | Snap gusset
description:
This cat bodysuit was designed to be worn for a full Halloween night out rather than as a costume that falls apart after one hour. The lace is a soft stretch blend that keeps its shape without digging in, and the bodysuit cuts high on the leg to stay smooth under a skirt or costume dress.

The ears and tail are both detachable with small silicone clips, so you can take them off before the rest of the evening. The gusset is a cotton-spandex snap closure rather than the usual synthetic lace, which matters if you are wearing it for a full day.

It reads as a costume without reading as a costume. Most Halloween lingerie is worn for about three hours in a dark room. This one is designed to survive dinner, a party, and the walk home.

WHAT MAKES IT WORK
• Detachable ears and tail — remove them when the costume part is over
• Cotton-spandex snap gusset, no synthetic lace against the skin
• Stretch lace that holds shape and does not dig in at the waist
• High-cut leg line so it stays smooth under skirts and costume dresses
• Machine washable on a delicate cycle

DETAILS
• Material: 82% Nylon, 18% Spandex lace; cotton-spandex gusset
• Color: Black
• Closure: Snap gusset; detachable ears and tail with silicone clips
• Pattern: Floral lace
• Origin: Made in China
• Care: Hand wash cold. Line dry. Do not bleach.

FIT & SIZING
True to size. If you are between sizes and want a firmer fit, size down. The lace has roughly 2 inches of stretch across the bust.
Model is 5'8" (173 cm) with a 34" bust, wearing size S.

Sizing tips:
• Measure your underbust — the band directly under the bust, snug but not tight. This matters more than the bust measurement for anything with a bodysuit fit.
• Measure your hip at the widest point, roughly 8 inches below the waist. This is the number most people underestimate.
• If you are between sizes, size up for sleepwear and lounge pieces, and size down for fitted bodysuits where you want a close fit.
• Fabric stretch varies by style. Each product page lists how much give the fabric has — styles listed as "about 2 inches of stretch" will size down more easily.
• Between a standard size and an extended size? Take the standard size. The jump to extended sizing changes torso length and gusset volume, not just the measurements.

QUESTIONS WE GET A LOT
Q: Do the cat ears and tail come off?
A: Yes. Both attach with small silicone clips and remove in seconds, so you can keep the bodysuit on after the costume portion of the evening is over.

Q: Is this bodysuit comfortable to wear for a full night?
A: The lace is a soft stretch blend and the gusset is cotton-spandex with snaps, not synthetic lace. Most Halloween lingerie is built for a few hours; this one is designed to stay comfortable through dinner, a party, and the trip home.

Q: Will it show under a skirt or costume dress?
A: The leg opening is cut high specifically to sit smooth under skirts and dresses without showing through the fabric.

Q: How do I wash it?
A: Hand wash or machine wash on a delicate cycle in a mesh laundry bag. Hang to dry. Do not use fabric softener on the lace — it reduces elasticity over time.
